title: Paying Alignment Tax with Contrastive Learning
religious_groups: Not specified, but used as a general category for debiasing
findings: Debiasing methods targeting religion, specifically Counterfactual Data Augmentation (CDA), often create a trade-off, or 'alignment tax'. While these methods can reduce the generation of toxic content, they frequently degrade model performance in other areas. For example, applying CDA for religion consistently decreased faithfulness in a summarization task across all tested models (GPT2, Phi2, Llama2-7B). Furthermore, analysis of the TruthfulQA benchmark showed that after debiasing interventions, models exhibited a decrease in multiple-choice accuracy on questions related to religion.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the 'alignment tax' associated with debiasing for religion. Specifically, it evaluated how applying Counterfactual Data Augmentation (CDA) to mitigate religious bias impacted model performance on other tasks, such as factual accuracy on the TruthfulQA benchmark (which includes a 'Religion' category) and faithfulness in the Reddit TL;DR summarization task.
